senses.en: used to introduce a fact that makes the main statement surprising or less simple

example.en: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
example.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是去散步了。

senses.en: up to a particular time and not after

example.en: The shop is open until nine.

senses.en: up to the time that something happens

example.en: Wait here until I come back.
